subject.title: Browser-opened temporary tabs/windows should close automatically after task completion

question: Should ordinary primary-agent task completion close run-owned temporary browser tabs by default, and what user actions should preserve a tab?
rationale: Current behavior intentionally keeps active primary-session tabs reusable, so changing the default requires maintainer intent around the terminal event, ownership marker, and preservation contract.

options.title: Run-owned cleanup with preservation
options.body: Track tabs created during a primary-agent run and close only those not explicitly foregrounded, pinned, or requested to be kept.

options.title: Keep idle/cap cleanup only
options.body: Treat current reusable-tab behavior plus background cleanup as the product choice and close this direction as not planned.

options.title: Opt-in strict cleanup
options.body: Add a documented opt-in cleanup mode while preserving reusable primary-session tabs by default.

recommendation.title: Run-owned cleanup with preservation
recommendation.body: Track tabs created during a primary-agent run and close only those not explicitly foregrounded, pinned, or requested to be kept.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete authored the current idle cleanup and reset cleanup boundaries most directly related to this product choice.
